select * from T_TC_GLUE_GROUP_ORDER where DEL_FLAG = 0
and INSTR(GLUE_GROUP_CODE, #{glueGroupCode}) > 0
and INSTR(GLUE_GROUP_NAME, #{glueGroupName}) > 0
order by ORDER_NUM
order by ${orderStr}
SELECT g.glue_group_name FROM T_TC_GLUE_GROUP_ORDER g, T_TC_GLUE_ORDER o WHERE g.id = o.glue_group_id AND o.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND GLUE_GROUP_ID in #{glueGroupId} group by g.id, g.glue_group_name
